articles.title_zh: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
facts_zh:
Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
- Published
An 80m (263ft) luxury vessel has been repeatedly spotted in satellite images off North Korea's Wonsan coast from July to mid-October this year.
What stands out is the 50m swimming pool along the deck, with a cluster of waterslides at one end.
After sitting idle for months at a maintenance facility, it relocated in early July to waters off a strip of coastline known as the Kalma Peninsula.

articles.title_zh: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
facts_zh:
Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
- Published
Demonstrators and riot police fought pitched battles in the centre of Tirana on Saturday for the fifth day in a row.
Masked protesters, many of them high school and university students, hurled rocks and petrol bombs at riot police trying to defend the education ministry, one of the focal points of the protests.
The police responded with water cannon and volleys of tear gas, sending the crowds scattering.

all_titles.en: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania

facts_zh:
Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
- Published
Violence broke out across France on Saturday during the latest day of demonstrations against hardship in schools and the cost of living.
At least 1,200 people were arrested during what the French government described as an "escalation in violence" alongside an estimated 550,000 taking to the streets.
In Paris, there were significant clashes into the evening with riot police, who used tear gas and water cannon on crowds.

articles.title_zh: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
facts_zh:
Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
- Published
Donald Trump blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect, as a row with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelensky deepens.
The sanctions were passed by the Congress and signed into law the president in September.
But Trump issued an executive order Friday night saying that suspending some was in the US national interest, prompting a backlash from US lawmakers.

articles.title_original: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
articles.title_zh: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
facts_zh:
At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
- Published
At least 17 people have been killed and many more injured in a crush at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark the Hindu festival of Durga Puja, officials say.
The incident occurred during sudden rainfall, which witnesses say prompted a surge of people to try to seek shelter.
West Bengal's Chief Minister Suvendhu Adhikari said a seven-year-old girl was among the dead, and that 25 people were being treated for injuries.

all_titles.en: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India

articles.title_original: Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
articles.title_zh: Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
facts_zh:
Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
- Published
Pope Leo XIV has been discharged from Rome's Gemelli Hospital, just four days after an operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung.
The 71-year-old walked unaided to his waiting car, stopping to speak to well-wishers.
The Vatican said the Pope will give the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing to a crowd in St Peter's Square on Sunday, as he did last week when he surprised the world by announcing the surgery.
